title: CasDeblurGS: Cascaded 2D-to-3D Multi-View Consistency for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Two Blurry Images
abstract: Free-viewpoint 3D scene media is increasingly important for immersive applications, yet practical capture often suffers from severe view sparsity and motion blur. Although neural rendering has advanced sparse-view synthesis, existing blur-aware methods typically require substantial multi-view redundancy, accurate camera poses, or costly per-scene optimization. We address a stringent yet practical setting: reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from only two motion-blurred images with known intrinsics, without input-view poses, auxiliary sharp images, or per-scene test-time optimization. To this end, we propose CasDeblurGS, a cascaded framework that progressively recovers reliable cross-view information from local 2D correspondences to global 3D guidance. Stage 1 constructs locally reliable guidance through occlusion-aware correspondence filtering, while Stage 2 aggregates the intermediate restorations into a provisional pose-free 3D Gaussian representation whose input-view re-renders provide dense global guidance for final restoration. The resulting views enable a more coherent 3D representation and higher-quality novel-view synthesis. Experiments on real-world and synthetic Deblur-NeRF scenes show consistent gains over strong baselines, improving PSNR by 1.19 dB and 2.11 dB, respectively. Progressive ablations, cross-view correspondence visualization, and camera reprojection analysis further demonstrate improvements in both rendering quality and multi-view geometric consistency.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.10345v1 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 not-found，未发布 Code link。
analysis.ideaZh: CasDeblurGS 把 blurry multi-view Gaussian reconstruction 分成 stabilization、2D blur correction 与 3D-aware refinement 的 feed-forward cascade；作者报告真实与合成 Deblur-NeRF 场景的质量/位姿一致性改善，但假设已知 intrinsics，且极端 motion blur、rolling shutter 和非刚体运动仍未覆盖。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它是退化观测下 feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction 的实用系统，对可控 3D capture pipeline 有参考价值。
analysis.evidenceZh: 级联分别处理 stabilization、2D restoration 与 3D consistency，避免把所有 blur ambiguity 交给单一 Gaussian predictor。（Sec. 3 and Fig. 2, p. 6）；3D stage 通过跨视图 reprojection signal 修正仅靠 2D sharpness 可能产生的几何漂移。（Secs. 3.3-3.4, pp. 8-10）；作者报告完整 cascade 在真实和合成 Deblur-NeRF scenes 上逐级改善 reconstruction metrics，并降低 symmetric camera reprojection error。（Tables 1-3, pp. 11-13）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：框架假设已知 camera intrinsics，并对极端 motion blur、复杂动态场景和错误 calibration 存在局限。；审阅风险：多个 learned stages 串联可能把早期 restoration hallucination 固化为 3D geometry，当前指标不足以排除这一风险。
analysis.motivationZh: 方法不做每场景优化，而是级联处理退化：先稳定跨帧 camera/motion signal，再在 image space 恢复可用观测，最后用 3D reprojection consistency 修正 Gaussian geometry 与 appearance。论文同时用 symmetric reprojection error 诊断真实场景的 camera consistency。
analysis.methodZh: 方法不做每场景优化，而是级联处理退化：先稳定跨帧 camera/motion signal，再在 image space 恢复可用观测，最后用 3D reprojection consistency 修正 Gaussian geometry 与 appearance。论文同时用 symmetric reprojection error 诊断真实场景的 camera consistency。 新意主要在把 blur correction 和 3D reconstruction 组织为 progressively constrained feed-forward cascade，并加入相机 reprojection 诊断；单个 deblurring/stabilization 模块并非独立新范式。
analysis.experimentsZh: 在 real-world 与 synthetic Deblur-NeRF scenes 上比较 deblurring、NeRF/GS reconstruction 及组合 baselines，报告 image-quality metrics、reprojection diagnostics、runtime，并作 progressive component ablation。 作者报告：作者报告完整 cascade 在真实和合成 Deblur-NeRF scenes 上逐级改善 reconstruction metrics，并降低 symmetric camera reprojection error。（Tables 1-3, pp. 11-13） Baseline boundary：覆盖 blur-aware rendering 和常见 restoration/reconstruction 组合；但场景规模较小，camera assumptions 与 input blur distributions 不足以代表手机 rolling shutter 或动态主体。 Ablation boundary：逐步加入 stabilization、2D、3D modules，能显示每层贡献；缺少不同 blur kernel、intrinsics error、non-rigid motion 和跨设备 domain shift 的系统测试。
analysis.insightZh: 新意主要在把 blur correction 和 3D reconstruction 组织为 progressively constrained feed-forward cascade，并加入相机 reprojection 诊断；单个 deblurring/stabilization 模块并非独立新范式。 建议略读 cascade 与 reprojection analysis；不把作者报告的重建改善外推到任意真实模糊视频。
